name: Professor Aspen
dialogues: Welcome to Verdania! Creatures live everywhere — in the grass, in caves, in the sea.
I study their interactions with humans. Your journey will help us all learn more!

name: Axel
dialogues: We grew up together but I'm going to beat you on this journey!
Every badge I earn, I earn faster than you. Watch me.

name: Your Mum
dialogues: Be safe out there! Come home to visit whenever you need rest.
I heard the Professor is giving away starter creatures today!

name: Healing Nurse
dialogues: Welcome! We restore your creatures to perfect health, free of charge.
Please come again any time!

name: Fisher Mike
dialogues: Psst — want an Old Rod? You can fish up basic water creatures with it!
Take it. I've got a better one now.

name: Ancient Sage Mira
dialogues: Long ago, a jade tablet was used to commune with the mythical source creature.
Legend says whoever returns the tablet to Myth Island Alpha shall meet Miraphel.

name: Island Elder
dialogues: You carry the jade tablet! The island's ancient stones resonate with its power.
Place it on the altar and the mythical guardian shall appear!

name: Ruins Scholar Fen
dialogues: This time shard vibrates with an energy I cannot explain.
Eight of them are scattered across Silverlands. Gather them to commune with Timelynx.

name: Captain Noro
dialogues: I sail between Verdania, Silverlands, and Tidewarden.
Defeat the Silverlands gyms and I'll take you west to Tidewarden — the Hoenn lands.

name: Devon Corp Researcher
dialogues: Tidewarden's Devon Corporation studies creature evolution and migration.
Welcome to our region! Three great conflicts shaped this land — fire, water, and sky.

name: Celestial Monk
dialogues: You carry all eight time shards! Timelynx senses your presence.
The time guardian approaches…

name: Frontier Guide
dialogues: The Stormspire Keep is ahead. Four Elite members guard the Grand Master.
Only trainers with all eight Hoenn badges may enter.
